# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

Nyte aims to provide a welcoming, respectful, and
collaborative community for everyone.

## Expected Behavior

- Treat contributors and maintainers with respect.
- Give constructive feedback.
- Respect different experiences and perspectives.
- Focus discussions on improving the project.
- Accept feedback professionally.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, or intimidation.
- Personal attacks, insults, or threats.
- Sharing another person's private information.
- Unwelcome sexual attention or sexualized conduct.
- Repeatedly disrupting project discussions.

## Scope

This policy applies to Nyte repositories, issues,
pull requests, discussions, and related community spaces.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns privately to the maintainers using
a contact channel provided by the affected repository.

If no private contact method is available, request one
without publicly describing sensitive incident details.

Reports will be reviewed with attention to privacy,
fairness, and the safety of those involved.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may edit or remove inappropriate content,
issue warnings, restrict participation, or ban individuals
from project spaces depending on the circumstances.
